Point Claude, Cursor or any MCP client at it

sources.fact: Free to start: a free key with no account and no card (limits are not stated on screen — the film sells the product, not the quota)
The six MCP tools: studio_status, list_voices, generate_voiceover, get_voiceover_status, list_recent_voiceovers, get_usage
No install, no SDK, no key purchase; the endpoint is stateless and speaks plain JSON over Streamable HTTP
The Studio interface with 29 voices, engine, rate and pitch controls
